name: Calendly
description: Calendly lets agents check availability, look up scheduled events and invitees, and manage event types and booking links. Each user signs in to their own Calendly account through the browser.

prompts.text: Which Calendly meetings do I have this week?
When am I free for a 30-minute meeting on Thursday?
Give me the booking link for my intro call event type.

apps.name: Calendly
apps.description: Availability, scheduled events, and booking links, over Calendly's MCP server with browser sign-in.
